objective: Add read-only detection of newer GraphPact releases as the first, safe piece of the update mechanism.
non_goals: No downloading or overwriting of vendored files in this change
No silent or automatic application of an update
No network access during normal contract validation

invariants: Contract validation and its CLI exit codes are unchanged
The default checker run performs no network access; only --check-update reaches the network
project.rollback: Revert the commit; --check-update disappears and the checker behaves exactly as before.

risk.rationale: Adds a public CLI subcommand to the portable checker and an opt-in network call.

acceptance.criterion: All prior checker behavior and contracts still validate.
check-update reports up-to-date, available, and failure cases correctly.

execution.rationale: The version comparison, CLI wiring, tests, and docs form one small shared change.

tasks.outcome: Add parse_version, latest_upstream_version, run_update_check, and the --check-update flag.
Cover the parser and the up-to-date, available, and failure paths, and document the command.
